# P2 development material

[CONSOLIDATED.md](CONSOLIDATED.md) is the maintained account of the current P2
policy, its scheduling rationale, performance tradeoffs, and retained evidence.

The current-production sanitizer runner is
`production-integration/validate.py`; it needs no old experiment checkout.
`summarize.py` summarizes the retained final benchmark data without rerunning it.
See [the package testing guide](../testing.md) for the other checks.
